Here's how to set up your Apple MagSafe Charger with your iPhone.

Setup instructions

Connect the MagSafe Charger to a USB-C power adapter (20W or higher recommended; some models support faster charging with a 30W adapter).

Plug the adapter into a wall outlet.

Place your iPhone on the MagSafe Charger with the back of the phone facing the charger.

Let the magnets align. The charger should snap into the correct position automatically.

Check the charging indicator. A charging animation should appear on your iPhone screen.

Do you need to configure anything?

No. MagSafe works automatically. You don't need Bluetooth pairing, an app, or any special settings.

Troubleshooting

If your iPhone isn't charging:

Remove thick or non-MagSafe-compatible cases.

Make sure the USB-C adapter provides enough power.

Disconnect and reconnect the charger.

Check that your iPhone supports MagSafe.

One question: Are you setting up the round Apple MagSafe charging puck, or a MagSafe charging stand (such as a 3-in-1 charger)?

Here's how to set up your Apple MagSafe Charger with your iPhone.

Setup instructions

Connect the charger: Plug the MagSafe Charger's USB-C cable into a compatible USB-C power adapter (20W or higher recommended).

Plug into power: Connect the adapter to a wall outlet.

Place your iPhone: Put the back of your iPhone against the MagSafe Charger. The magnets should automatically align.

Check charging: Your iPhone should display a charging animation or charging indicator.

Important tips

No Bluetooth pairing or app is required.

For faster charging, use a compatible USB-C power adapter.

MagSafe works best with a MagSafe-compatible case or no case.

iPhone 12 and newer models generally support magnetic MagSafe charging, with some model-specific differences.

For a MagSafe charging setup at home and in your car, I'd recommend building around one simple idea: effortless magnetic charging, with no cables to plug into your iPhone every time.

The ideal setup has three parts:

Bedside: A MagSafe stand for overnight charging, ideally with Apple Watch and AirPods charging.

Desk or living room: A magnetic charging stand that holds your phone upright for notifications and video calls.

Car: A secure MagSafe charging mount with a dedicated USB-C power connection.

I'd prioritize Qi2-certified chargers, strong magnets, good heat management, and adjustable viewing angles.
